title: Smile or They'll Know I'm Human: Undercover Among the Mimics
genre: Chinese anime (donghua), supernatural horror survival with dark comedy
notes: Source audio is the original Chinese (Mandarin) voice track, not an English dub: each line's "en" field is Chinese speech recognition, and "on_screen" is the film's own English subtitle. Translate the meaning from both into natural Mongolian (on_screen is the cleaner wording when the Chinese is misheard). Chinese names in the usual Mongolian Cyrillic form (Lin -> Линь, Xiao -> Сяо); speaker names in English/pinyin.
